column1: # Regression pool — one row per probe.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' or empty 'name' column are skipped.
#   name              short id (used for filenames + baseline lookup)
#   app               app+version key (matches stage.sh URLS row)
#   probe_dir         repo-relative path to probe .class dir
#   max_seconds       perf envelope (regression flag if exceeded)
#   baseline_file     file in baselines/ to diff stdout against
# Apps that need their distros restaged (not on disk today; stage.sh downloads):
# NIO / buffer / VarHandle coverage (JDK-only, hermetic). These exercise the
# non-gated changes from commit d6cefc7 (DirectByteBuffer layout, VarHandle
# meta ops, Unsafe arena routing). classpath_glob is just $PROBE_DIR — no app
# routes through Util.getTemporaryDirectBuffer (an Unsafe arena handle) →
# FileDispatcherImpl.write0/read0, plus the real FileChannelImpl path
# FileReadWrite fd_table I/O). Enabled once R2 + the FileChannel.open
